title: 26th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/26/1/2025).

Question from Keyodhoo MP Mohamed Niushad to the Minister of Education, Dr Ismail Shafeeu: the 2024 state budget included a four-storey building and a boundary wall for V. Keyodhoo School; why did the funded project not start last year, and when will actual work begin?

From the Speaker's desk: the Judicial Service Commission's referral, under Article 154(b) of the Constitution, for the removal of Supreme Court Justice Dr Azmiralda Zahir from office is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the Judicial Service Commission's referral, under Article 154(b) of the Constitution, for the removal of Supreme Court Justice Al-Ustaz Mahaz Ali Zahir from office is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the Maldives Civil Aviation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé Central MP Abdulla Shazmee.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Housing Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu Central MP Asma Rasheed.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to gauge members' views on the Chair acting in ways that obstruct the Majlis's work, contrary to the Constitution and the Standing Orders.
Report of the Social Affairs Committee on its review of the bill amending the Sports Act (Law No. 30/2015).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the education minister about a stalled Keyodhoo school project, sent the JSC's removal cases against two Supreme Court justices to committee, introduced the Civil Aviation Bill, continued the Housing Bill and a resolution on the Chair's conduct, and took up a Sports Act amendment report.
